title: BUGFIX — achiri-reengage.ts: filter test/E2E users from inactive user list
rationale: workspace/achiri/reengage-log.jsonl shows 400 'chat not found' Telegram errors for synthetic E2E user IDs (e.g. e2e-test-*, validate-sprint-*). Same root cause as Sprint 1416: achiri-reengage.ts builds allUsers from all keys in daily-counts.json including test IDs injected by validate-e2e-alpha.ts. Fix: after building allUsers Set, filter to only keep numeric chatIds using REAL_USER_REGEX = /^-?\d+$/.

tasks.description: In scripts/achiri/achiri-reengage.ts main(): after building allUsers Set from counts, filter out any userId that does not match /^-?\d+$/ (real Telegram chatIds are always numeric). Log how many non-numeric users were skipped.
